schedule_detail: Teacher schedule plus SLP credential stipend
max_all_basis: District's published SLP Super Max: top + master's $3,128 + credential $7,619 + CA SLP license $3,130.
duty_day: 40 hrs/week, at least 35 on site (about 7 a day); same as teachers
notes: BA+45 step 1 to BA+75 step 27. With license, top reaches $153,498. +1.26% for 2025-26 plus 1% one-time. Hourly $47.29.

schedule_detail: Shared 'Teacher/SLP' points-based schedule, plus a $2,500 stipend for SLPs with the ASHA CCC
max_all_basis: Top with longevity + CCC or NBCT $2,500 (one or the other) + doctorate $2,500. Unit credit ($267.90 per unit) and growth points could add about $22,500 more if paid on top of the range.
addon_note: CCC stipend $2,500 (teachers get the same amount for National Board). Counted in the max, not in start and top, because clinical fellows don't yet hold a CCC
duty_day: 35 hrs/week on site (about 7 a day); same as teachers
other_stipends: CCC or NBCT $2,500; doctorate $2,500; $267.90 per unit and growth point; longevity up to $5,358
notes: Top = Range 7 step 23 ($157,258.47) plus 23-year longevity ($5,358.04). MA range starts at step 0. Unit credit and growth points may add more (unclear on the schedule). +1% for 2026-27. Hourly $54.29–$62.03.

schedule_detail: Teacher schedule; SLPs start at step 6 or higher
max_all_basis: Top + ASHA allowance $1,500 + licensed billing/CF supervision $3,500 + doctorate $600.
duty_day: No set length: hours ‘appropriate to the school day’; non-student days up to 6.5 hrs plus lunch
other_stipends: +$3,500 if licensed and willing to bill and supervise CFs; doctorate $600
notes: Start = step 6 of Col C (BA+30), the lowest placement for SLPs hired since 7/1/2023 (up to step 10 with experience). An SLP with more units would start in Col D or E. Top = Col E 27+ year longevity. 2026-27 not yet settled.

max_all_basis: Top of the doctorate + National Board column. BCLAD $1,500 (shortage assignments) left out.
duty_day: No set length: 30 min before students until duties are done; non-student days up to 6 hrs plus lunch
other_stipends: BCLAD $1,500; doctorate and NBCT columns reach $170,214
notes: Col A step 1 to Col B (BA+75 + MA) step 28. SLPs choose a 186- or 191-day contract at hire; figures here use the 191-day schedule. +2% for 2025-26. 2026-27 reopener pending. Hourly $51.36.

schedule_detail: Speech Language Therapist schedule (Matrix 10), separate from teachers
caseload: Average of 55 (contract restates Ed Code 56363.3, so the SELPA local plan can set a higher average); 40 if preschool only
duty_day: No set length: up to 30 min before students plus a reasonable time after; same as teachers
other_stipends: Doctorate $3,500; NBCT $1,000 (both listed on the SLP schedule)

caseload: Education Code maximums, with an appeal process
duty_day: No set length: 30 min before students until a sufficient time after; non-student days 7 hrs. SLPs get 240 prep min every 2 weeks and 10 release days
contract_ref: APLE 2022-25 Art. XI B, Art. XVI

schedule_detail: Teacher schedule A-1 plus SLP stipend
max_all_basis: Top + SLP stipend $9,864 + doctorate (1% of Class IV). Bilingual stipends left out because they depend on the assignment.
caseload: None found so far (Special Services article not read yet)
duty_day: Flexible duty day: the instructional day plus required meetings, about 6.5 hrs in practice (the contract sets no number)
other_stipends: Bilingual BCLAD ~$3,992 or CLAD ~$2,395 where the assignment qualifies
notes: Class IV step 1 to step 26. +2.5% for 2026-27. The SLP stipend (Art. 7.6.7-B, effective 7/1/2022) is written for 'all active employed Speech and Language Pathologists at the time of Board approval of this Agreement', which may leave out later hires.
